title: Infra: pyproject.toml, _client.py, _errors.py, _registry.py
description: Foundation layer for the refactor. (1) Add dazpy as an editable path dependency in pyproject.toml via [tool.uv.sources] pointing to ../daz-script-server. (2) Create _client.py: DazClient + DazScene singletons, async wrapper run_dazpy(fn) using asyncio.to_thread, and get_scene()/get_daz_client()/get_http_client() accessors. (3) Create _errors.py: map dazpy exceptions (NodeNotFoundError, ConnectionError, ScriptRuntimeError, AuthenticationError) to FastMCP ToolError with helpful messages. (4) Create _registry.py: extract the _REGISTRY dict and _register_scripts() logic from server.py. (5) Create tools/__init__.py that imports all tool modules so server.py just does import vangard_daz_mcp.tools. All subsequent module tasks depend on this one.
close_reason: Created _client.py, _errors.py, _registry.py, tools/__init__.py; updated pyproject.toml with dazpy editable dep

title: MCP Server Refactor: dazpy SDK integration + module separation
description: Refactor daz-mcp-server from a 15K-line monolith into a clean modular architecture. dazpy becomes the primary SDK layer (called via asyncio.to_thread); inline DazScript strings are the fallback for operations dazpy does not cover. The 128 existing tools are preserved; 11 new tools are added; the codebase is split into 14 tool modules plus shared infrastructure. See MCP_SERVER_DESIGN.md in daz-script-server for the original design spec.
close_reason: Closed

title: Phase 6.4: Apply material preset from .duf file
description: daz_set_material_property exists for individual property edits, but there is no way to apply a full material preset .duf file (e.g. a skin material pack). Add: daz_apply_material_preset(node_label, preset_path) → loads the .duf material preset and applies it to the named node using DzFileIOSettings + App.getContentMgr().openFile() or equivalent; daz_copy_material(source_node, source_material_name, dest_node, dest_material_name) → copies all property values from one material slot to another within the same scene. These fill a significant gap for production-quality rendering workflows.
close_reason: Closed

title: Phase 6.5: Figure diagnostics — detect generation and list morphs in use
description: No single tool tells you which Genesis generation a loaded figure is, which blocks generation-agnostic scripting. Add: daz_get_figure_info(figure_label) → returns generation (Genesis3/Genesis8/Genesis9/other), sex, active morphs with non-zero values, fitted item count, and current subdivision level. Also add daz_set_subdivision(node_label, level) → sets the SubDivision Level property on a figure or prop (integer 0-4). These are foundational diagnostics needed before posing, fitting, or rendering a figure correctly.
close_reason: Closed

title: Phase 6.3: Pose library — save and load named poses from file
description: No tools exist for saving or loading poses from the DAZ pose library. Add: daz_save_pose(figure_label, pose_name, output_path) → serialises all bone rotations/translations to a .duf pose file at output_path via Scene.saveScene or DzExportMgr with appropriate filters; daz_load_pose(figure_label, pose_path) → loads a .duf pose file onto a figure, optionally limiting to specific bone groups (arms_only, legs_only, spine, full). This allows building and reusing pose assets outside of DAZ Studio's UI.
close_reason: Implemented daz_save_pose and daz_load_pose with vangard-collect-pose and vangard-apply-pose DazScript, bone_group filtering, and JSON pose file format.

title: Phase 6.1: Wardrobe tools — list fitted items and auto-fit clothing
description: No tools exist for managing clothing/props fitted to a figure. Add: daz_list_fitted_items(figure_label) → lists all nodes currently fitted/parented to that figure with type (clothing, hair, prop, accessory); daz_fit_clothing(clothing_label, figure_label) → runs DAZ's Auto-Follow/Transfer Utility via DazScript to fit an already-loaded clothing item to a figure; daz_unfit_item(item_label) → removes fit and detaches from figure. Use Scene.findNodeByLabel + node.getNumNodeChildren / getFigure().getNumFollowTargets() or the DzFigure fitting API. These are missing from the current 114-tool set and block realistic character assembly workflows.
close_reason: Implemented daz_list_fitted_items, daz_fit_clothing, daz_unfit_item with DazScript registry entries and 15 passing mock tests

title: Phase 6.2: dForce simulation control — run, bake, and configure cloth/hair sim
description: No tools exist for dForce. Add: daz_run_dforce_simulation(node_label, start_frame, end_frame) → triggers cloth/hair simulation via DzSimulationMgr or the equivalent DazScript API; daz_bake_simulation(node_label) → bakes the simulated frames to keyframes so the result is preserved; daz_set_dforce_property(node_label, property_name, value) → sets dForce modifier properties (stiffness, gravity multiplier, etc.) on a node. This is essential for realistic clothing and hair in rendered scenes.
close_reason: Added daz_run_dforce_simulation, daz_bake_simulation, daz_set_dforce_property — 3 tools using DzSimulationMgr; probes for method names with helpful fallback errors listing available methods

title: Add daz_wait_for_scene_event using GET /scene/events SSE stream
description: The daz-script-server now exposes GET /scene/events as a Server-Sent Events stream with categories: node, skeleton, light, camera, selection, scene, time, render. Filter with ?filter=render,scene etc. Events include render.started, render.finished, scene.loaded, scene.saved, node.added, selection.primary_changed, time.changed (debounced 150ms), playback.started, etc. Add a daz_wait_for_scene_event(event_types: list[str], timeout_seconds: int = 30) MCP tool that opens an SSE connection, parses event frames (data: {type, ts, data}\n\n), and returns when one of the requested types fires or timeout is reached. Most immediately useful: waiting for render.finished after daz_render(), detecting scene.loaded after daz_load_file(). Uses httpx streaming (client.stream). Add mock tests using respx streaming mock.
close_reason: Implemented daz_wait_for_scene_event with SSE streaming via GET /scene/events; 7 mock tests added to test_server.py, all passing.

title: Add daz_save_scene_copy using POST /scene/save-copy endpoint
description: The current daz_save_scene tool uses Scene.saveScene(path) via DazScript which changes the scene's internal filename pointer when saving to a new path (it becomes a Save As, not a copy). The daz-script-server now has POST /scene/save-copy which handles this correctly: for clean scenes it does a pure file copy (no DAZ API calls); for dirty scenes it saves to the dest path then restores the original filename. Add a new daz_save_scene_copy(path) MCP tool that calls this endpoint and returns {ok, path, source, method}. Add mock tests in test_server.py verifying it calls /scene/save-copy and not the script registry.
close_reason: Implemented daz_save_scene_copy using POST /scene/save-copy with 5 tests

title: Phase 6.6: Scene export — write FBX or OBJ from selected nodes
description: No export tools exist. Many pipelines (game engines, VFX) need geometry out of DAZ. Add: daz_export_fbx(node_labels, output_path, options) → exports the named nodes to FBX via DzExportMgr with format 'Filmbox'; daz_export_obj(node_labels, output_path, options) → exports to Wavefront OBJ. Options include: include_morphs (bool), apply_current_pose (bool), scale_factor (float). Use DzExportMgr.doExport(filename, exporterName, settings) pattern. Gracefully return an error if the required exporter is not installed.
close_reason: Closed

title: Add daz_search_content integrating daz-content-browser vector search
description: The daz-content-browser project runs a FastAPI server with POST /api/v1/search for semantic vector search over the installed DAZ product catalog (BAAI/bge-large-en-v1.5 embeddings, ChromaDB). Also has POST /api/v1/scene/load to load a .duf by absolute path (delegates to daz-script-server). Add two MCP tools: (1) daz_search_content(query: str, max_results: int = 10) — calls content browser POST /api/v1/search and returns product list with sku, name, description, compatible_figures, tags, store_url. (2) daz_load_product(product_name: str) — calls /api/v1/products?q=name then /api/v1/scene/load. Content browser URL configurable via DAZ_CONTENT_BROWSER_URL env var (default http://localhost:8080). Use a separate httpx client (not the DAZ script server client). Skip gracefully if content browser is not reachable. Add mock tests.
close_reason: Implemented daz_search_content and daz_load_product with separate httpx client, graceful fallback, and 14 mock tests all passing
